subject: Fix TSAN build for integration tests (#818)
reason: The change modifies only build/CI scripts (build.sh and scripts/common.rc): it sets TSAN_OPTIONS instead of LSAN_OPTIONS for thread-sanitizer CI builds, adds a TSAN-specific third-party build directory, and sed-patches Valkey core sources during sanitizer CI builds. No module source code changes, so the module's runtime behaviour is identical on both builds; there is no command, reply, replication, persistence or failover path the change can affect, and nothing for a scenario to exercise.
